journals.summary: Resolved x86-64 stack frame misalignment faults in recursive factorial subroutine. AMD64 ABI mandates 16-byte RSP alignment before CALL instructions.
journals.keyInsight: System V AMD64 ABI enforces 16-byte stack boundary alignment before call instructions.
journals.aiFeedback: Excellent low-level reasoning on stack frame preservation.

journals.summary: Built RAII custom memory pool arena in modern C++20 with std::unique_ptr custom deleters.
journals.keyInsight: Arena memory pooling completely removes per-object heap allocation overhead in tight loops.
journals.aiFeedback: Clean memory safety verification confirmed via Valgrind.

journals.summary: Inspected callee-saved registers (%rbx, %r12-%r15) across nested subroutine frames using GDB layout regs.
journals.keyInsight: Preserving callee-saved registers on stack entry prevents subtle variable corruption in callers.

journals.summary: Implemented red-black balanced binary search tree rebalancing rotations and node recoloring.
journals.keyInsight: Tree rotations maintain logarithmic search guarantees with zero memory leaks.
journals.aiFeedback: Great grasp of self-balancing tree invariants.

journals.summary: Traced Linux system calls using strace and implemented custom write() wrapper in raw GNU assembly.
journals.keyInsight: System call convention in x86-64 puts syscall number into %rax and uses syscall opcode instead of int 0x80.
journals.aiFeedback: Accurate breakdown of modern 64-bit Linux syscall interface.
